procedure.instruction: Rest the full fingertip centered on the sensor without pressing, then keep the finger, board and cable still.

passedCriteria: The normal product profile recognized real contact after a no-finger baseline.
Five consecutive diagnostics reached the internal VALID state.
LED amplitude settled at 0x18 after the contact transition.
limitations: The valid BPM outputs ranged from 78 to 214 and were not compared with a reference device.
Most contact diagnostics remained INESTABLE or SIN DATOS.
This evidence accepts the technical sensor-to-firmware path, not measurement accuracy.
acceptance.nextStep: Improve temporal stability and reject implausible rapid BPM variation without relaxing signal-quality gates.
